INGRID SOLBERG
Oslo, Norway | ingrid.solberg@example.com | +91-00000-02301

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Machine learning researcher with six years of post-doctoral research
experience in self-supervised learning and model evaluation. Deep PyTorch
and Python; designed and ran large ablation studies and built evaluation
harnesses adopted by two labs. I have not owned production serving, model
registries, or SQL feature pipelines: my work has run on academic SLURM
clusters against curated research datasets.

SKILLS
- Python: research codebases, packaging, NumPy, typed refactors
- PyTorch: custom architectures, distributed training, fine-tuning
- Evaluation: benchmark design, ablations, significance testing, error analysis
- Experimentation: SLURM job orchestration, reproducible seeds and configs
- Writing: peer-reviewed publications, technical reports, reviewing service

EXPERIENCE

Senior Research Scientist — Aldervik Centre for Applied AI, Bergen
September 2023 to May 2026
- Led a three-person project on robustness of vision-language models;
  first-author paper published in 2024.
- Built the centre's evaluation harness: 30 benchmark tasks with pinned
  seeds, bootstrap confidence intervals, and regression alerts, reused
  by two other research groups.
- Fine-tuned transformer models up to 3B parameters with distributed
  PyTorch across a 64-GPU SLURM allocation.
- Supervised two doctoral students on experiment design and honest
  reporting of negative results.

Research Fellow — Skagerrak Institute for Cognitive Systems, Oslo
February 2020 to August 2023
- Researched contrastive self-supervised learning; first-author paper
  published in 2022 plus two co-authored papers.
- Implemented training pipelines in PyTorch with mixed precision and
  gradient checkpointing on institute clusters.
- Ran ablation studies across 400+ configurations with a config-driven
  experiment runner I wrote and shared lab-wide.
- Served as a reviewer for two major machine learning venues.
